children: WORLDWIDE NFT, INC. ANNOUNCES HIRING OF FINN DUNNE AS VP OF M&A
OTC:WNFTannounces that the Company has hired Peter (“Finn”) Dunne, Jr. as its Vice President of Mergers and Acquisitions - https://www.wnft.us/." />
MCLEAN, Va., Oct. 05, 2026
-- Worldwide NFT, Inc.
(“WNFT” or the “Company”) announces that the Company has hired Peter (“Finn”) Dunne, Jr. as its Vice President of Mergers and Acquisitions, reporting to CEO Jay Wright.
Mr. Dunne graduated from
, where he majored in Finance and played on the

. He has significant transaction experience over the past several years, including in leveraged finance, acquisitions, and capital structure. He will be working out of the Company’s Northern Virginia office.

“I am very pleased to have Finn join WNFT and provide his strong transaction background to our Company,” said Jay Wright, WNFT CEO. “Finn brings rigor to our analytical work and creativity to our origination work. He will be an excellent addition to the team.”

“I am excited to join Jay in helping to grow WNFT and create a large, successful technology company in the U.S. defense and federal civilian industries,” said Finn Dunne. “Defense tech is one of the most dynamic areas in the U.S. economy, and helping the Department of War’s mission by enabling the warfighter with the best possible cyber tools is something I look forward to helping support.”
About Worldwide NFT, Inc.

Worldwide NFT, Inc. (OTC: WNFT; WNFT) is a publicly traded company focused on acquiring strong operating companies, including looking to make accretive acquisitions in the defense, tech, manufacturing, or related industries - https://www.wnft.us/.
